scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:css: cat css/base.css css/sidebar.css css/sections.css css/experience.css css/skills.css css/certifications.css css/components.css css/responsive.css | npx lightningcss --minify > dist/styles.min.css
scripts.build:js: cat scripts/ui.js scripts/navigation.js scripts/print-handler.js scripts/experience.js scripts/skills.js | npx terser --compress --mangle > dist/scripts.min.js
